name: Short Springtip
description: Drives the point straight at the opponent's chest with the arm extended from a balanced forward stance.

name: Level Twinspine
description: Sweeps the edge across at shoulder height while the hips turn behind the blade.

name: Driftdrop
description: Cuts upward from a low guard along the opponent's centerline toward the chin.

name: Descending Ripple
description: Drops the edge from a raised guard to waist height in one downward cut.

name: Eddypace
description: Steps one pace backward while the point stays aimed at the opponent's lead hand.

name: Angled Guardwing
description: Turns the wrist to lift the flat of the blade and push an incoming cut aside.

name: Quick Flitter
description: Flicks the point at the opponent's wrist or hand with a quick snap of the wrist.

name: Raised Ridgecrest
description: Raises the blade flat across the brow and face to cover the upper body.

name: Watching Knotcord
description: Holds the point toward the opponent and feels the weight and drift of the opposing blade.

name: Sideways Lilt
description: Steps a quarter circle around the opponent's lead foot to change the line of attack.

name: Tasselwedge
description: Presses the opponent's blade downward with the flat to spoil the next thrust.

name: Steady Waistbend
description: Holds a deep stance with the sword extended to build leg strength and a steady sword arm.

name: Sharp Flexspine
description: Slices along the outer edge of the blade across the opponent's forearm.

name: Swirlhit
description: Draws the inner edge back across the opponent's wrist while stepping out of reach.

name: Narrow Springtip
description: Delivers two quick thrusts at the throat and then the belly along the same line.

name: Skipping Drift
description: Slides one foot sideways off the opponent's line while the blade stays raised.

name: Solid Guardwing
description: Tucks the blade over the forearm to stop a straight cut aimed at the head.

name: Calm Pommeltuft
description: Lifts the free hand behind the back to keep balance through a long extended thrust.

name: Judging Tassel
description: Points two fingers of the free hand along the sword's line to fix distance and direction.

name: Straight Flitter
description: Thrusts the point along the line first traced by the free sword fingers.

name: Gnawing Knotcord
description: Hooks the point behind the opponent's guard hand and pulls it back across the arm.

name: Settled Jianhilt
description: Brushes the opponent's sword wrist aside with the open free hand while the point drives in.

name: Ripplehop
description: Closes distance with two quick short steps while the sword stays steady at the hip.

name: Wide Twinspine
description: Cuts with one edge then flips the wrist to cut back with the other edge.

name: Tight Twinspine
description: Meets an incoming cut with the thick spine side so the opposing edge cannot bite.

name: Ripplestrike
description: Turns the hips and cuts backward along the line the blade just thrust.

name: Stepping Lilt
description: Slides along the line of the opponent's edge to stay outside its reach.

name: Willowstay
description: Holds the blade upright beside the ear so that any cut at the head meets steel.

name: Swirlbump
description: Pokes the point at chin height from a half step away and recovers at once.

name: Swirlhusk
description: Swings the pommel tassel across the opponent's eyeline to draw a flinch before cutting.

name: Fouling Jianhilt
description: Draws the blade from under a wide sleeve so the opponent cannot read the angle.

name: Lilthit
description: Flicks the blade out of the sleeve fold in a short cut at the opponent's hand.

name: Hard Pommeltuft
description: Taps the pommel into the opponent's ribs or hand at close range.

name: Lilttrot
description: Enters the opponent's reach with slow even steps so the tassel and blade stay still.

name: Rippleblow
description: Runs a thin thread of qi along the edge before a cut so it bites deeper into guards.

name: Ready Flexspine
description: Pushes a little qi into the flat to turn aside a cut with less force from the arm.

name: Single Swirl
description: Chains three thrusts along one flowing line while qi circulates evenly through the sword arm.

name: Tasselskitter
description: Times each step to a breath so the body moves forward without breaking the blade's line.

name: Downward Eddy
description: Returns along the path of the previous cut with the other edge using the blade's flex.

name: Even Waistbend
description: Holds an even breath cycle so the qi stays steady through a long exchange.

name: Keen Crestedge
description: Draws the blade across the opponent on the in-breath with qi pulled into the sword arm.

name: Leaden Swirl
description: Drives the point forward on the out-breath with a short push of qi behind it.

name: Holding Jianhilt
description: Holds the breath and a covering blade position while qi firms the forearm against a blow.

name: Swaying Tassel
description: Steps into the gap between the opponent's breaths to close the distance unseen.

name: Deep Flexspine
description: Sends a short pulse of qi into the wrist so the next cut snaps faster.

name: Measured Knotcord
description: Reads the opponent's chest and breath rhythm along the blade to time a counter.

name: Eddyblow
description: Sweeps the blade out on one breath and back on the next in a single linked pass.

name: Willowblow
description: Cuts at the crown of the head in a drooping arc with a light qi edge.

name: Flexblow
description: Slants a cut across the side of the neck with the wrist bending like a reed.

name: Flexdash
description: Cuts diagonally down toward the opponent's ribs from a half-raised guard.

name: Firm Tassel
description: Drops low and cuts across the opponent's knee before rising back to guard.

name: Willowdash
description: Lifts the edge under the opponent's sword wrist in a short upward cut.

name: Swirlpace
description: Pivots on the lead foot to face each of four corners while the point tracks the opponent.

name: Easing Flitter
description: Advances with the rear heel brushing the ground so the stance never rises.

name: Skipping Eddy
description: Sidesteps in a crescent arc outside the opponent's reach and returns to the line.

name: Flitter Dash
description: Advances in small steps with the point hovering at the opponent's face to force a retreat.

name: Eddy Hit
description: Lunges forward into a thrust then steps back to the starting stance in one rhythm.

name: Lowered Guardwing
description: Lands from a step with the blade already covering the body's center line.

name: Open Waistbend
description: Bends the blade by a pull of the wrist so the tip whips around the opposing guard.

name: Kept Flexspine
description: Lets the flat bend against an incoming cut and spring it back to the side.

name: Mild Springtip
description: Sets the tip quivering against the opponent's blade to feel pressure and intent.

name: Driftstrike
description: Flicks the point back along the arc of the whip cut into the opponent's flank.

name: Flexskitter
description: Slides the blade off a bind using its flex and steps out of the clinch.

name: Sharp Lilt
description: Opens the daily drill with a clean diagonal cut along a marked line on the floor.

name: Straight Ripple
description: Follows with a straight thrust held for a count at full extension.

name: Resting Pommeltuft
description: Closes the drill with a rising parry that sweeps an imagined blade off the line.

name: Driftamble
description: Shuffles forward and back along the drill line with the blade held level.

name: Flat Drift
description: Lunges on the third count of the drill with the whole body behind the point.

name: Tasselnote
description: Returns the blade to the scabbard in one motion while letting the qi settle.
